# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Age:** School-age child (around six to ten years old)  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Status:** Schoolboy  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony is a small boy with a dark, sullen little face and black eyes.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)_

## Personality

Anthony is independent, stubborn, and mischievous, with an impertinent swagger and a contemptuous attitude toward authority. He holds a strong prejudice against female teachers, believing them to be 'no good' and showing his disdain through insolence and defiance. Despite his rebellious and sullen nature, he is capable of respecting those who stand their ground against him, ultimately showing a grudging respect when confronted firmly.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050)_

## Goals

- To defy and mock female teachers  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026)</sub>

## History

Anthony Pye is an orphan who was taken in by his aunt and uncle, Mr. and Mrs. George Pye, in Avonlea. When Anne Shirley takes over the Avonlea school, Anthony becomes her most difficult pupil, persistently holding a prejudice against girl teachers. He repeatedly displays insolence, such as pouring water down a classmate's neck and mocking Anne during her first days. Later in the term, after Anthony puts a live mouse into Anne's desk to frighten her, she loses her temper and gives him a whipping with a hardwood pointer. Although Anne feels deeply ashamed of using corporal punishment, the act surprisingly earns Anthony's respect, as he values a firm hand. From that point on, Anthony behaves much better toward Anne, lifting his cap to her and offering to carry her books to school.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P31](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0031), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P36](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0036), [v2 c12 P48](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0048), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050)_
